subject: SIG v9: proposed revision, re-answers, and diff review
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-payments.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-payments.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG v9 — suggested question changes and new control IDs (attachment)

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for walking us through the Hosted API controls last week. Our security team did a pass over the vendor SIG v9 and flagged three areas where the new questionnaire introduces changed phrasing and a handful of new control IDs. I've attached a spreadsheet (SIG_v9_change_proposal.xlsx) that maps Acme's requested clarification items to the corresponding SIG question IDs and proposes the re-answer wording we expect from vendors.

Important items:
- Q3.4.1 (data residency language) — customer wants explicit fallback behavior for routed inference.
- Q6.2.7 (key management) — new HSM-related sub-questions; need evidence for KMS provider and rotation policy.
- Q8.1.2 (third-party subprocessors) — includes a new required disclosure field for marketplace partners.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide updated re-answers to these items and an annotated diff of what changed versus the SIG v7 answers you previously provided? We have a procurement deadline the week of July 6 and would like the SIG finalized before contract signature.

Liam
Procurement / Acme Payments

Attachment: SIG_v9_change_proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet — proposed question mapping)

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-payments.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v9 — suggested question changes and new control IDs (attachment)

Liam — thanks for the clear mapping and the deadline heads-up. We're happy to handle this. Quick plan:

1) I'll own assembly of the re-answers for the three flagged sections and create an annotated diff (v7 vs v9).
2) Neha will pull evidence (SOC2 snapshot, KMS rotation policy extract, subprocessors list) and attach PDFs.
3) Karthik will review any commit language around routing/fallback that touches Dedicated/private offerings.

Can you confirm whether Acme requires redlines in the SIG file itself or if a separate "re-answers + diff" package is acceptable? We can produce either, but the former may take a bit longer to author into the canonical SIG schema.

I'll target an initial set of re-answers and the diff by EOD Monday (2026-06-22). If you need it sooner, let me know which items are highest priority.

Best,
Aisha
Lead, Security & Compliance (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference

--
Aisha Rahman
Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v9 — evidence pulls and suggested artifacts

Uploading the initial evidence set now. Summary of what I'm attaching to our internal folder and will include with external re-answers:

- redwood-evidence-snapshot-202605.pdf — includes SOC 2 summary, key controls matrix (encryption, access, monitoring).
- kms-rotation-policy-extract.txt — concise rotation schedule and roles.
- subprocessors-current.csv — current marketplace/integration vendor list (redacted where appropriate).

Notes: the HSM question is new; we don't hold a dedicated HSM in-host for hosted API customers today. We use cloud KMS providers with envelope encryption and customer-facing options in Private deployments for HSM-backed keys. Proposed re-answer language attached in SIG_v9_reanswers_tracking.csv — it calls out where we need to differentiate hosted/dedicated/private behavior.

If Acme requires an explicit HSM artifact, we should surface the Private deployment option and the customer-managed KMS path in our re-answer rather than claim HSM for hosted. I flagged this in the CSV.

Neha
Sr. InfoSec Analyst, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-evidence-snapshot-202605.pdf; SIG_v9_reanswers_tracking.csv

From: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-payments.com>, procurement@acme-payments.com
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG v9 re-answers and annotated diff (initial package)

Liam / Acme team — attaching our initial deliverable per your request. In this package you will find: 

1) SIG_v9_reanswers_tracking.csv — our proposed re-answers for the v9 questions you flagged. Each row includes: question ID, v7 answer excerpt, v9 proposed answer, and an "explanation" field where we note product constraints.
2) SIG_v9_change_proposal.xlsx (annotated) — your original mapping with inline comments from Redwood.
3) redwood-evidence-snapshot-202605.pdf — SOC 2 summary and control evidence excerpts.

Highlights and clarifications:
- Q3.4.1 (data residency / routing fallback): We added explicit fallback wording that clarifies routing preference order and tenant isolation guarantees. For Hosted API customers we note that regional fallback is to a compatible region within the same compliance tier; Dedicated and Private customers may pin replicas.
- Q6.2.7 (KMS/HSM): We provided the KMS provider and rotation cadence used across hosted fleets; for HSM-specific items we propose an alternate answer that references Private deployment options and KMS integrations (customer-managed keys).
- Q8.1.2 (subprocessors): We included the subprocessors_current.csv as a separate redacted extract.

Action items for Acme: please confirm whether the alternate HSM wording is acceptable, or if you need a statement expressly confirming HSM-backed key custody for the Hosted API (which we cannot provide). Also indicate whether you want the re-answers produced directly in the SIG canonical JSON or if this package (re-answers + annotated diff + evidence) is sufficient for procurement.

If acceptable, we'll upload the canonical SIG JSON with the updated answers within two business days and include a tracked-diff file for your records.

Best,
Aisha
Lead, Security & Compliance (Sales Enablement)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_v9_reanswers_tracking.csv; SIG_v9_change_proposal.xlsx; redwood-evidence-snapshot-202605.pdf

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-payments.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG v9 re-answers and annotated diff (initial package)

Aisha / team — thanks, this is very helpful and clear. A couple quick points from Acme Sec Ops: 

- The alternate HSM wording is acceptable if we get an explicit path described in the contract (Private deployment + customer-managed KMS). Please add a short sentence that we can insert into the SOW referencing Private options.
- We prefer the canonical SIG JSON with annotations (tracked diff) for our compliance team record. Can you produce that in your next upload?

If you can get the canonical JSON + diff by Thu (2026-06-25), we can slot this into our procurement timeline. Otherwise, the packet you sent will be used as an interim record.

Appreciate the quick turn.

Liam

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG v9 canonical JSON + tracked diff (final upload)

Liam — attaching the canonical SIG v9 JSON with our updated answers plus a tracked-diff CSV that highlights changed question IDs and answer text. A few operational notes: 

- We inserted a single-line SOW clause template to your requested wording around Private deployments and customer-managed KMS; see clause SOW-3b in the attachments.
- Where we could not provide an HSM artifact for Hosted API, we included a pointer to the Private deployment play and a contact for solution engineering to scope a dedicated key custody arrangement.
- We included a "versioned_answers" field in the JSON (metadata) so you can see v7 -> v9 mappings; separate tracked-diff CSV includes row-level diffs.

Please confirm receipt. If this satisfies Acme's compliance team, we can mark the SIG as "accepted for procurement" and proceed with contract redlines.

Thanks — and happy to hop on a short call if anyone wants to walk the diff live.

Aisha
Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_v9_canonical.json; SIG_v9_tracked_diff.csv; SOW-3b_template.txt
